newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan FGEP group to tender for 54,000T US corn.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan FGEP group to tender for 54,000T US corn.

text.p: Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Thursday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of corn, traders said on Tuesday.

The tender would be Taiwan's first return to the world corn market since the government reported an epidemic of hog foot and mouth disease on March 20 and ordered a pork export ban and islandwide drive to slaughter or inoculate 14 million hogs.
Taiwan importers cancelled several corn tenders and halted at least one purchased shipment in the wake of the announcement as the mass slaughter slashed demand for feed corn.
A group buyer said Thursday's tender specified corn of U.S. origin. Unlike recent Taiwan corn tenders, the FGEP group made no mention of Latin American grain in calling the new tender.
The buyer said the group was lured back into the market by sharp recent rises in U.S. wheat prices, which importers feared could in turn push corn prices higher.
"The strong wheat prices could fuel for a corn rally," he said.
The FGEP group comprises Fwu Sow Grain, Great Wall Enterprise, President Enterprise, Ever Smile Feed Mill Co and group newcomer Fong Yu.
